title: ui: `romanizeHan.test.ts` "before the dictionary has loaded" fails when another unit test in the same worker loaded the pinyin dictionary first (unit project runs with isolate: false)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filed by the seat from PR #36651 (#36648). Source: a red `Test UI (7/16)` on that PR, in a file the PR does not touch.

Suggested-grade: p1 (a red on a PR that does not touch the file; any PR can draw it, and a merge-queue run that draws it ejects the PR)
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`
Suggested-area: `area:fleet`

## Signature

- Job 137580509219 (`Test UI (7/16)`), PR #36651 head `6e21473c66d90fda5eabac0affa9dc6982511c16`, 2026-11-23 09:03Z.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/romanizeHan.test.ts > romanizeHan before the dictionary has loaded > returns the text unchanged and reports the Chinese text as pending`
- `AssertionError: expected ' weixiu  zhongxin ' to be '维修中心'` at `romanizeHan.test.ts:24:33`. 1 failed, 2840 passed in the shard.

## Reading (by the seat, not yet reproduced)

- The file is a `.test.ts`, so it runs in the `unit` project, which sets `isolate: false` (`ui/vitest.config.mts` near line 390). Module state is shared by every file a worker runs.
- The file's header says its first `describe` reads the module **before** the dictionary is loaded, because that state is module-wide. Under `isolate: false` that holds only if no earlier file in the same worker called `loadHanRomanizer()`. The output `' weixiu  zhongxin '` is the loaded dictionary's reading, so one had.
- So the red depends on which files the shard puts in the same worker ahead of it, not on the PR under test. A PR that adds or moves test files can shift that and draw it.

## Fix direction (for the developer to confirm)

Make the "before load" cases independent of earlier files: e.g. read a fresh module instance (`vi.resetModules()` + dynamic import) for that `describe`, or move those cases to a file in an isolated project. Never skip, quarantine or retry. The product behaviour (text unchanged and pending until the dictionary loads) stays pinned.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "isolate: false" ui/vitest.config.mts` and `git grep -ln "loadHanRomanizer" ui/packages -- '*.test.ts'`
